relationships.subject: Panx1
relationships.evidence_quote: Thus, these results show that Panx1 contributes to long-term reference memory and that deletion of Panx1 from either astrocytes or neurons results in similar memory deficits

relationships.subject: Panx1
relationships.evidence_quote: In slices from Panx1-null mice, the magnitude of TBS-induced LTP was significantly decreased compared to hippocampal slices from Panx1f/f mice

relationships.subject: Panx1
relationships.evidence_quote: slices from Panx1-null mice also showed impaired LTD induced by low-frequency (2 Hz/10 min) stimulation

key_findings: Global, astrocyte- or neuron-specific Panx1 deletion impairs long-term spatial reference but not working memory.
Panx1-null mice show attenuated Schaffer collateral-CA1 LTP and LTD.
